RecoveryReminder: Prepare recovery before experimenting. Save your work; this app does not create a Windows restore point.
GalleryHelp: Search one list and use its checkboxes to choose what appears. Unknown items are hidden by default.
TabsDescription: A historical experiment for keeping folders together in one window.
SearchDescription: A historical experiment for finding processes by name or ID.
WidgetsDescription: A historical experiment for a larger space for widgets.
NavigationDescription: A historical experiment for reorganizing the navigation pane.
StepReviewBody: Select to enable; clear to disable. Windows default and unknown are shown separately.
StepApproveBody: A separate administrator worker applies this change.
StepRestartBody: Save your work first. Restart is always manual.
BriefWarning: Experimental changes can affect stability. Prepare recovery first and try one experiment at a time.
ReviewSubtitle: Select to enable; clear to disable. Windows default and unknown are shown separately.
Tagline: Windows features, one checkbox at a time.
ExploreSubtitle: Find a feature and use its checkbox to change it. Inspect sources and current state first.
CoverageNote: Catalog presence does not establish support on your Windows build. Missing observations do not mean disabled.
Schematic: Original conceptual illustration · not a Windows screenshot
UnknownDescription: The upstream name is a technical identifier. Behavior, prerequisites, dependencies and build compatibility are unverified. This app does not infer them from the name.
Historical: Historical example only. The illustration describes a category, not the appearance or availability of this feature on your PC.
DefaultHelp: Default removes this user override; it does not mean disabled. Other Windows priorities may still win. A restart is required after changes.
NoChanges: No changes yet. Use a feature checkbox to get started.
ReviewHelp: These changes affect only the listed user boot overrides. Experiments can make Windows unstable. Save your work and arrange a recovery path. Apply one experiment at a time when possible.
HistoryHelp: Read-only records of operations and their results. Pending does not mean success. Restore Windows default separately from the feature’s details.
UpdateHelp: Updates come only from BlakeLiAFK/ViVeUI releases on GitHub and are checked against GitHub’s SHA-256 asset digest. Automatic downloads do not install updates; click Install update to install.
AutoCheck: Check for updates when this app opens
AutoDownload: Automatically download verified updates after a successful check
Current: You have the latest published version
Ready: Verified package ready · open folder to install manually
Failed: Check or download failed · see details below
AboutHelp: ViVeUI. Full pinned upstream source, licenses, original artwork and build instructions ship with the source package. No telemetry. Browsing is offline and does not require elevation.
Restart: Verified changes saved. Restart Windows when you are ready.
Empty: No matching features. Try a shorter name or inspect a numeric ID.
InvalidId: Enter one decimal feature ID from 1 to 4294967295.
Unchanged: This matches the current override. Nothing changed.
SafetyAck: I understand this experimental change and its exact feature ID and state.
FailureIntegrity: The package or release source could not be verified. Nothing was installed.
FailureConflict: The current state differs from the recorded snapshot. Refresh before trying again.
FailurePermission: Access was denied or administrator approval was canceled.
FailureUnsupported: This Windows build or override format is not supported. No unsupported values will be changed.
FailureStorage: The local file or history could not be read or saved. Check access and available space.
FailureIpc: The administrator worker could not be authenticated or did not complete. Check history and current state before retrying.
FailureNetwork: The update source could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
FailureRequest: The request is invalid or exceeds the allowed scope. Review the IDs and states.
FailureNoRelease: No published release is available yet.
GuideNoApply: This guide opens information or a Windows settings page; it does not change features.
GuideEvidenceNote: Documented versions, not a universal minimum build. Availability may vary by channel and rollout.
GuideRestart: Opening this page needs no restart. Follow Windows prompts after manual changes.
GuideRiskSettings: Review the Windows options before changing them. This app opens the page only.
GuideRiskClassic: No verified universal ViVe ID restores the classic menu. This shortcut makes no persistent registry change.
GuideRiskInsider: Preview rollout only. This app cannot force-enable the menu and does not assume stable-channel support.
GuideRiskEndTask: Ending a task can lose unsaved work. Save first; do not end unfamiliar system processes.
GuideRiskPower: Battery, brightness or sleep behavior may change. Review each option separately.
GuideRiskFiles: Showing names is read-only. Renaming extensions or changing hidden files can break apps.
GuideRiskClipboard: Clipboard history can contain sensitive data; cloud sync is a separate choice.
GuideRestoreNone: Nothing to undo: this opens a menu or guide without changing persistent settings.
GuideRestoreSettings: Record the old value and restore it in the same Windows page. ViVeUI history cannot undo external settings.
RetryReview: The change failed or was not attempted. Refresh the current state before trying again.
WaitForApply: Wait for the active change operation to finish before closing.
ClosePending: Close ViVeUI? Applied changes remain in effect.
KernelDescription: Historical Task Manager diagnostic experiment. Dumps can contain sensitive memory; build support is unverified.
GuideClassicMenuBody: Right-click a file and choose Show more options. Shift + right-click opens the full menu on documented builds. This does not permanently replace the menu.
GuideContextMenuBody: Where the preview has rolled out, choose Customize menu or Personalization > Context Menu. No forced activation is provided.
GuideEndTaskBody: Find End task in Advanced (25H2) or For developers on earlier versions. Save work before using the taskbar command.
GuideTaskbarLabelsBody: Personalization > Taskbar > Taskbar behaviors: choose how buttons combine and when labels appear.
GuideTaskbarSmallBody: Taskbar behaviors > Show smaller taskbar buttons: choose Always, When full or Never, where available.
GuideClockSecondsBody: Time & language > Date & time: show seconds in the system tray clock. This uses more power.
GuideVolumeBody: Win + Ctrl + V opens the quick mixer on supported builds. The settings page lets you adjust app volumes.
GuideExtensionsBody: File Explorer > View > Show > File name extensions. Recognize file types before opening or renaming them.
GuideHiddenBody: File Explorer > View > Show > Hidden items. Visibility does not grant permission to edit system files.
GuideExplorerHomeBody: File Explorer > … > Options > Open File Explorer to > This PC. Choose Home again to restore.
GuideSnapBody: System > Multitasking > Snap windows. Win + Z shows available window layouts.
GuideAltTabBody: System > Multitasking: choose which recent Edge tabs appear alongside open windows in Alt + Tab.
GuideEnergyBody: System > Power & battery > Energy recommendations. Review changes individually; available options depend on hardware.
GuideFocusBody: System > Focus: choose a duration and start a session. End the session when you want to stop.
GuideClipboardBody: System > Clipboard: choose history and cloud sync separately. Win + V opens the history.
CatalogRiskNone: No system change is made by viewing this entry.
CatalogRiskUnsavedWork: Save your work; this action can close apps or interrupt ongoing tasks.
CatalogRiskFiles: Check the selected files and keep a backup before changing or deleting content.
CatalogRiskPrivacy: Review what is shared or visible and who can access it.
CatalogRiskPower: Availability and battery impact depend on your hardware.
CatalogRiskAccessibility: Keep an accessible way to reverse the setting if interaction becomes difficult.
CatalogRiskExperimental: Historical evidence does not establish support on this device. No activation is offered here.
CatalogRiskNetwork: Changing this setting can affect connectivity or data usage.
CatalogRiskSecurity: Review the security implications before changing the setting.
CatalogRestartApp: Reopen the affected app if the change is not visible.
CatalogRestartSignOut: You may need to sign out and back in; save work first.
CatalogRestartDevice: A device restart may be required; save work and restart manually.
CatalogRestartVaries: Restart requirements depend on the documented build and setting.
CatalogRestoreNone: No persistent change is made by this guide.
CatalogRestorePreviousSetting: Return to the same setting and restore its previous value.
CatalogRestoreCloseView: Close the view or return to the previous window.
CatalogRestoreBackup: Restore from your backup if the operation cannot be undone.
CatalogRestoreManual: Use the source instructions and your recorded previous configuration; no automatic rollback is provided.
ToggleHelp: Select to enable; clear to disable. Windows default and unknown are shown separately.
ToggleDefaultState: Windows default — no explicit enable/disable override
FilterHiddenMatch: A matching ID is hidden. Select “Show unknown items” to see it.
FilterHelp: Filters only change this list. Known descriptions do not confirm support on this Windows version.
InputIdHelp: Inspect one ID, including IDs outside the dictionary. Querying does not change settings.
InputIdNotCatalog: Not in the pinned dictionary. Purpose and availability are unverified.
InputIdNotObserved: Not observed on this device. Availability is unknown.
InputIdKnown: In the pinned dictionary. This does not confirm support on this device.
UpdateInstalled: The update is ready at the original location. This session is still running the previous version.
UpdateRestartPrompt: Restart ViVeUI now to use the installed update?
UpdateInstallHelp: Click Install update to replace the executable. You will then be asked whether to restart ViVeUI.
UpdateRecovered: The previous executable was restored. Try installing again.
RecipesHelp: Find a feature by name, review its device evidence, and manage its overrides. Windows guides are in a separate view.
RecipeSearch: Search features by name or ID
RecipeFilterHelp: Applicability reflects device evidence, not the current override state.
RecipeReadFailed: Could not read the current state
RecipeRestartHint: Save your work before restarting Windows manually; restart needs vary.
RecipeResultFailed: The change failed. Refresh the state before trying again.
RecipePurposeVoiceTypingFilter: Choose whether voice typing masks profanity. Enabling this recipe exposes the choice; it does not turn the filter off.
RecipePurposeQuickAccessibilityGroups: Group accessibility controls in Quick Settings by vision, hearing, and mobility.
RecipePurposeVoiceVocabulary: Add custom words to the Voice Access vocabulary.
RecipePurposeVoiceQuickSettings: Add a Voice Access toggle to the accessibility controls in Quick Settings.
RecipePurposeSharePhotoEditing: Edit and compress local images before sharing in Windows Share. Both feature IDs work together.
RecipePurposeHdrSettingsHistory: Expand HDR and Dolby Vision settings. Available options depend on your display hardware.
RecipePurposeExplorerAiActions: Add image AI actions to File Explorer context menus. Both feature IDs work together; actions depend on installed apps.
RecipeCaveat: A saved override does not prove visible feature availability. Disabling is not a verified visual rollback; Default removes the user override.
RecipeEvidenceHelp: These are documented observations, not a supported build range. An ID appearing on this device does not prove compatibility.
